statusLine.command: bash -c 'input=$(cat); model=$(printf "%s" "$input" | jq -r ".model.display_name // empty" 2>/dev/null); if ! git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then git="(not a git repo)"; else branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown"); dirty=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); if [ "$dirty" -gt 0 ]; then git="$branch · ✎$dirty"; else ahead=$(git rev-list --count main..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$ahead" -eq 0 ]; then if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "HEAD" ]; then git="$branch · ✓"; else git="$branch · ✓ merged"; fi; else git="$branch · ↑$ahead"; fi; fi; fi; printf "%s%s\n" "${model:+$model · }" "$git"'
